title: City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to amending the Los Angeles Administrative Code to increase Los Angeles Zoo admission fees.
text:
[Council File 26-0600-S22]
City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to amending the Los Angeles Administrative Code to increase Los Angeles Zoo admission fees.
(This item is referred to the Arts, Parks, Libraries, and Community Enrichment Committee and Budget and Finance Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Increase admission fees for the Los Angeles Zoo.

locations.text: Los Angeles Zoo, Los Angeles, CA

outcome.text: Council approved Arts, Parks, Libraries, and Community Enrichment and Budget and Finance Committees report dated August 18, 2026, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51; Ordinance held over to September 16, 2026 for a second reading (Sep 9, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 16, 2026); Council action final
